svg.title: S06-structured-sequence — source snapshot (not a runtime trace)

g.text: S06-structured-sequence — source snapshot (not a runtime trace)
same local transaction: business + integrity + version + SUCCESS audit
begin: center/root authorization → captureUpper before mutation
GrantVersion Java Long id maps physical TINYINT, not BIGINT.
DDD local derives actual actor identity-role snapshot before append.
No independent SUCCESS commit; timestamps have millisecond precision.
Spring interceptor COMMIT after normal method return; failure blocks success response.
denied is a separate REQUIRES_NEW DENIED event, not business SUCCESS.
AOP method/log timing is neither audit_log nor proof of DB commit.
